name: multica-cli-skill
description: Reuse the user's existing Multica CLI login (~/.multica/config.json) to create, query, and update Multica issues and manage comments, attachments, statuses, and project workflows via Bash + curl + jq. Fuzzy-matches assignees and projects by name. Aligned with Multica v0.7.x (custom statuses, project workflows, attachment download). Works on Windows Git Bash, macOS, and Linux.
